```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"The adage that “a rising tide lifts all boats” has been replaced by a scorched earth model of economic development.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The scorched earth model of economic development despoils once-high living standards in advanced industrial democracies.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The scorched earth model of economic development emphasizes short-term profit and financial speculation, giving rise to recurrent international financial crises.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Recurrent international financial crises have wiped out much of the middle classes of Latin America and Southeast Asia.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"U.S. military spending is today neither legitimate nor prudent.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The United States today spends more on its armed forces than does the rest of the world combined.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The cost of growing and maintaining an empire is contributing to the demise of social and economic democracy at home.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Democratic forces in advanced industrial democracies traditionally used their power politically to create state policies that guaranteed labor rights.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Democratic forces in advanced industrial democracies traditionally used their power politically to raise government revenues through progressive forms of taxation.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Democratic forces in advanced industrial democracies traditionally used their power politically to fund high-quality universal public goods such as free public education, accessible health care, and child care.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"To sustain high levels of productivity, “welfare states” generously funded research and development and job training relevant to the needs of a dynamic economy.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[4]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
